tagline: Piattaforma di Trading Automatico Istituzionale & Smart Money Flow
archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Institutional Trading Terminal)
emotional_tone: High-precision, tactical, ultra-secure, institutional-grade, data-dense, dark command center
design_principles: Precision over Decorative Slop: Zero AI-purple gradients (#7351B7 banned). Use deep obsidian (#0B0E17 / #0F172A) with crisp 1px subtle borders.

Semantic Color Discipline: Emerald Green (#10B981 / #00D4AA) for bullish/gain/buy, Crimson Red (#EF4444 / #FF4757) for bearish/loss/sell, Amber Gold (#F59E0B) for institutional liquidity sweeps/Order Blocks.
Monospaced Data Precision: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono for all financial values, PnL, lot sizes, order prices, timestamps, and order block zones.

Italian Institutional Terminology: 'Analisi Liquidità', 'Order Block Istituzionale', 'Fair Value Gap (FVG)', 'Struttura di Mercato (BOS/CHoCH)', 'Simulatore Backtest 98% Winrate', 'Connessione Broker Tickmill'.

High Density Layout (Mode B): Dense 4-column cockpit with L2 simulated order book, candlestick chart with Smart Money overlays, AI signal feed, active bot control widget, and backtest performance metrics.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

layout_and_grid.mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Trading Dashboard Cockpit)
layout_and_grid.grid_structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-3 md:gap-4

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#0F141C]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Brand Logo: Apex Flow (with glowing cyan status dot 'Claude 4.6 Active')
Live Market Ticker Marquee (EUR/USD, BTC/USDT, XAU/USD, NVDA, US30)
Mode Switcher (Conto Demo $100.000 / Tickmill Real Broker Pending)
Quick Action: Bot Emergency Kill Switch / Fast Order Execution
User Profile Avatar + Account Balance Badge ($100,000.00 Demo USDT)

login_auth_screen.style: min-h-screen bg-[#080B10] flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative overflow-hidden
features: Card with glassmorphism border-slate-800 bg-[#0F141C]/95 p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl rounded-xl
Mode Selector: 'Accedi con Account Demo (Gratuito)' vs 'Connetti Broker Live (Tickmill)'
Pre-filled Demo Login CTA ('Entra nel Terminale Demo')
Trust Badges: Encryption 256-bit, Tickmill ECN Bridge Ready, Claude Sonnet 4.6 Engine
Background: Simulated order book depth map background with low opacity

ai_smart_money_panel.title: Analisi Istituzionale AI (Smart Money Concepts)
features: Bias Istituzionale: Strongly Bullish / Liquidity Sweep Detected (Score 98%)
Order Block Active Zones (OB H4 / FVG M15 / Break of Structure)
Liquidity Map Indicator: High-volume buy/sell stops pools identified
AI Trade Setup Generator: Entry Price, Stop Loss below Swing Low, Take Profit 1/2/3
Sonnet 4.6 Institutional Reasoning narrative card in Italian

bot_control_panel.title: Pannello Bot Trading Automatico
features: Bot Status Toggle: [ATTIVO - IN ESECUZIONE] / [PAUSA]
Target Winrate Protection System: Algoritmo impostato su 98% Winrate Filter
Risk Management Config: Max drawdown (e.g., 1.5%), Lot Sizing (Dynamic % Equity), Max Open Trades (3)
Broker Gateway: Tickmill ECN Demo Bridge (Latenza 2ms)
One-Click Emergency Stop ('Pulsante di Blocco di Emergenza')

backtest_runner.title: Simulatore & Runner Backtest 98% Winrate
features: Interactive Historical Range Slider (1 Mese, 6 Mesi, 1 Anno, 3 Anni)
Equity Curve Chart (Area Chart high contrast emerald line with fill)
Key Metrics Display Cards: Win Rate (98.2%), Profit Factor (4.12), Max Drawdown (-1.4%), Total Trades (428), Total Net Profit (+€48,290.00)
Forward-Testing Live Log Monitor

candlestick_chart.title: Grafico Ticker & Struttura di Mercato Live
features: Timeframe Selector: M1, M5, M15, H1, H4, D1
Overlays Toggle: Order Blocks (OB), Fair Value Gaps (FVG), Premium/Discount Zones, Liquidity Sweeps
Simulated Real-time Price Stream with tick animations
Indicators Bar: RSI, Order Flow Delta, Volume Profile

positions_table.title: Posizioni Aperte & Storico Esecuzioni
features: Tabs: Posizioni Attive (3), Ordini Pendenti (1), Storico Operazioni (142)
Columns: Simbolo, Tipo (BUY/SELL), Lotto, Prezzo Ingresso, Prezzo Corrente, SL, TP, PnL Non Realizzato (€ / %), Azioni (Chiudi Ora)
Monospaced data cells with green/red PnL badge highlighting

micro_interactions_and_motion.hover_effects: Subtle border lighting, bg-slate-800/60 shift, hover text transition (no transition: all)
micro_interactions_and_motion.active_bot_pulse: Animate pulse indicator dot on Bot Status Badge (green ring animation)
micro_interactions_and_motion.price_tick_flash: Brief green/red background flash on price tick changes in orderbook and chart ticker
micro_interactions_and_motion.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for order execution toasts ('Ordini automatici eseguiti con successo', 'Stop Loss aggiornato')
micro_interactions_and_motion.keyboard_shortcuts: Press 'B' to buy, 'S' to sell, 'Space' to pause bot, '/' to search instruments

testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: APCA 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large data headers
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab ordering on order inputs and control toggles

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Apex Flow trading terminal app in React JS (using .js/.jsx components in src/components/).
Use Italian language for all titles, labels, tools, tooltips, and AI Smart Money analysis reports.
Default to a dark, high-contrast institutional trading layout using the specified slate/obsidian palette.
Implement the simulated live candlestick chart (using Recharts or Lightweight Canvas) with Order Block & Liquidity zone overlays.
Implement the Bot Control panel with live start/stop state, risk config inputs, and emergency stop.
Implement the Backtest engine visualizer showcasing the target 98% winrate metric, drawdown curve, and profit metrics.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tables, and stat badges contain their respective data-testid attributes.
Integrate Sonner toasts for trading alerts and order executions.
